name: Lalon Shah Bridge
facts: Lalon Shah Bridge, completed in just over three years after its foundation stone was laid in January 2001, opened on 18 May 2004, becoming Bangladesh's third longest road bridge.
The 1.8‑kilometer, 18.10‑meter wide bridge features 17 prestressed concrete box girder spans of about 109.5 meters each, engineered by China Major Bridge Engineering Co. Ltd.
Named after the mystic poet Lalon Shah, the bridge not only links northern districts to the southern port of Mongla but also supports freight to the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant.
